title: MosaicRV microarchitectural geometry for one profile

decode_width.description: Declared, not yet consumed by the RTL (docs/scalability-plan.md S-1). The decoder (mosaic_decoder) produces one control word per cycle today, so an absent key means a decode width of 1, the RTL's literal -- not zero. When present it must be >= 1 and >= rename.rename_width: you cannot rename what you cannot decode, and a rename wider than the decode leaves its ports permanently starved.

idec_queue_entries.description: Declared, not yet consumed by the RTL (docs/scalability-plan.md S-2). The decoded-instruction queue (mosaic_idec_queue) depth is the literal 8 in mosaic_core.sv today, so an absent key means depth 8 -- the RTL's literal, not zero. No cross-field constraint names it yet; it is declared here so S-2 has one place to look.

commit_width.description: Declared, not yet consumed as a key by the RTL (docs/scalability-plan.md S-3). The generated MOSAIC_RETIRE_WIDTH is rename.dispatch_width today (tools/gen_manifest.py), so an absent key means that literal -- not zero. When present it must be >= 1 and <= 2 * rob.max_uops_per_macro: a retire width of zero never retires, and one wider than twice the largest macro retires beyond anything the front end can ever present.

fp_units.description: Declared, not yet consumed by the RTL (docs/scalability-plan.md S-3). The machine instantiates one mosaic_fp_unit and one FP issue pipe today, so an absent key means one FP unit -- the RTL's literal, not zero. Counted across the fabric (the FP unit is shared, not per cluster).

vec_units.description: Declared, not yet consumed by the RTL (docs/scalability-plan.md S-3). The machine instantiates one vector engine today and the lane broker treats lanes as an attribution rather than parallel datapaths, so an absent key means one vector unit -- the RTL's literal, not zero. Counted across the fabric.

remote_link_latency.description: registered round-trip latency in cycles for a remote operand or result transfer

pmp.description: Physical Memory Protection (Priv v1.12 2.7). A profile without this block implements no PMP entries, which is the correct description of a hart with no less-privileged mode.

entries.description: Priv v1.12 2.7.1: implementations may implement zero, 16 or 64 PMP entries, and the lowest-numbered entries are implemented first.

granularity_bytes.description: The grain 2^(G+2) from Priv v1.12 2.7.1.1; must be a power of two. 4 means G=0 and NA4 is selectable.
